answer: Each identity posts a 40 POA bond and earns only when five distinct buyers pay it in an epoch; buyers sharing one funding wallet count as one, so a fake ring's income falls to its nadir, zero. If two identities share over 80 percent of their buyers, both bonds burn as a clone ring. Like saffron, genuine demand is scarce and dear: every fake costs 40 POA plus real fees to five real buyers, no bridge of sockpuppets replaces them, and the cost scales linearly per fake added.
